initial_condition: Identical fine-mesh checkpoint copied with its existing processor partition; no interpolation from coarse mesh.
purpose: Test local persistence of fine pressure spikes under algebraic, coupling and time-step changes; baseline restart controls for checkpoint effects.
limitations: This is a short checkpoint-response experiment, not an independently initialized full validation trajectory.
Coupling branch changes a group of correction counts; it cannot attribute the effect to one individual count.
Lower pressure extremes alone do not prove higher physical accuracy.
No production mesh is accepted automatically, and no acceptance tolerance is relaxed.
